# Noor Tower Business Bay

> Noor Tower is a 20-storey residential building on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, Dubai, with sixteen apartment floors above a ground floor and three podium parking levels. Around 124 one- to three-bedroom apartments and duplexes range from roughly 1,000 to 3,300 square feet across some 33,400 square metres. Amenities include a swimming pool, gymnasium, sauna and steam rooms, a business centre and a children's play area.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Business Bay, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2019

## MENASCO Scope

Noor Tower is a 20-storey residential building on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, developed by Al Ansari Real Estate and designed by APG Architecture & Planning Group. Sixteen residential floors sit above a ground floor and three podium levels, with amenities including a swimming pool and gym. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the building.
